title: Balanced Ore Detector Enchantments
description: Allows all Balanced Ore Detectors to be given Unbreaking and Mending enchantments.
body:
Requires the [Balanced Ore Detector](https://modrinth.com/mod/oredetector) mod to use this datapack.

Allows all 10 Ore Detectors to be given Unbreaking and Mending through an Anvil.
